name: apishift
description: Autonomous API migration and breaking change healing engine
author: Alexandr Motologa

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('src/spec/builtins', 'dist/spec/builtins', { recursive: true });"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const stub = 'fixtures/sample_openai_project/stubs/openai'; const dest = 'fixtures/sample_openai_project/node_modules/openai'; if (fs.existsSync(stub) && !fs.existsSync(dest)) { fs.mkdirSync('fixtures/sample_openai_project/node_modules', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync(stub, dest, { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && cd web && npm run build
